title: Mystery vs. History
cn: 第 6 集 · 神秘与历史
novel: Ted decided to go on a date without [[researching|research]] the girl online first. He wanted to keep things [[mysterious|mysterious]] and [[spontaneous|spontaneous]]. He had always looked up his dates on the internet before meeting them. This time, he chose to learn about her in person. The gang was [[skeptical|skeptical]] of his [[approach|approach]] but [[respected|respect]] his decision. Kevin, Robin's new boyfriend, watched how the group [[interfered|interfere]] with each other's lives. He saw how they always gave their [[opinions|opinion]] about everything. He [[observed|observe]] that Ted was struggling not to search for his date's name on the internet. Ted held his phone and [[tempted|tempt]] himself to look her up. He finally resisted the [[temptation|temptation]] and went to the date with a clear mind. On the date, Ted asked questions and listened [[carefully|carefully]]. He discovered that the girl was actually very [[interesting|interesting]]. She told him stories he never could have found online. Meanwhile, Kevin [[realized|realize]] how deeply the group [[cared|care]] for each other. Their constant [[interference|interference]] was actually a sign of [[affection|affection]]. Kevin told Robin that he understood why they acted the way they did. He said their [[bond|bond]] was [[unique|unique]] and special. Ted returned from his date feeling [[refreshed|refresh]] and happy. Sometimes, not knowing everything made things more exciting.

research.en: to study something to learn facts

interfere.en: to get involved in others' business

tempt.en: to make someone want to do something

temptation.en: a strong desire to do something

unique.en: being the only one of its kind
